exposure: second trimester placental location (fundal, unilateral, low)
outcome: ante partum hemorrhage due to placental praevia
cohort: Antenatal women aged 18 to 35 years without any high-risk factors.
finding: Second trimester placental location significantly correlated with preeclampsia, ante partum hemorrhage in placental praevia, intra uterine growth restriction, low APGAR at 1 minute, and NICU admission.
